title: Search performance degradation for large document sets (>5M documents)
affected_customers: ACME Corp (11.2M docs), Pinnacle Systems (8.7M docs), CloudSync Systems (6.1M docs)
workaround: Use specific filters (date range; document type; author) to narrow search scope before querying. This reduces Elasticsearch query scope significantly.

title: Document upload intermittent failure for files between 50MB and 200MB
affected_customers: ACME Corp, GlobalTech Inc (reported but lower frequency)
workaround: Split files into smaller segments under 50MB. Compression reduces file sizes significantly for PDFs.

title: Search returns deleted documents for up to 15 minutes after deletion
workaround: Refresh search after 20 minutes if a deleted document still appears in results.

title: Mobile app iOS crashes when previewing PDFs with more than 20 pages
affected_customers: SkyBridge Ltd (primary reporter); estimated 8% of mobile users affected
workaround: Download PDF to device and open with native PDF viewer instead of in-app preview.

title: Analytics dashboard shows incorrect user count for parent accounts with sub-accounts
workaround: Navigate to each sub-account separately and aggregate counts manually. Or use Analytics API with parent tenant_id.

title: Search export CSV does not properly quote fields containing commas
affected_customers: All customers using CSV export with documents that have commas in metadata fields
workaround: Use JSON export format instead of CSV. JSON correctly handles all special characters.

title: AI summarization returns empty response for scanned PDFs without embedded text
affected_customers: Customers using AI features with scanned documents
workaround: Use AI summarization only on documents with embedded text (most modern PDFs, Word docs). Scanned documents must first be processed through an OCR tool externally.

title: Search filter by tag causes 500 error when tag contains special characters (% [ ] { })
affected_customers: All customers using tag-based search filters with special character tags
workaround: Remove special characters from tag names. Use alphanumeric characters and hyphens only in tags.

title: Kafka consumer lag during peak hours causes notification delays of 5-10 minutes
affected_customers: All customers - affects document upload confirmations and workflow notifications during 9-10 AM PT
workaround: No direct workaround. Notifications will arrive but may be delayed during peak hours.

title: Mobile app search results page fails to paginate on iOS 17.3+
affected_customers: iOS 17.3+ mobile app users only (estimated 35% of mobile users)
workaround: Use web browser (Safari or Chrome) instead of the mobile app for searches requiring multiple result pages.

title: Workflow automation email notifications show timestamps in UTC instead of user timezone
workaround: Fixed in v2.13.2 deployed March 8 2026

title: SSO login fails for Azure AD tenants with MFA when challenge takes >30 seconds
workaround: Fixed in hotfix deployed March 5 2026. SAML assertion validity window increased to 300 seconds.

title: SCIM user sync fails when user group name contains an apostrophe
workaround: Fixed in v2.13.1 deployed March 1 2026

title: Search suggestion (autocomplete) not working for queries starting with numbers
workaround: Type the full search term without relying on autocomplete for numeric-prefixed queries.

title: Bulk document import stops processing after 1000 documents silently
workaround: Fixed in v2.13.1. Bulk import now correctly handles unlimited document counts.

title: Webhook delivery retry incorrectly handles 429 response from customer endpoint
workaround: Fixed in v2.12.0 deployed February 1 2026

title: Invoice PDF generation fails for accounts with more than 500 licensed users
workaround: Fixed in v2.13.2. Invoice PDFs now generated asynchronously for large accounts.

title: Slack integration sends duplicate notifications when Slack API returns 503
workaround: Fixed in v2.13.2 via idempotency key implementation.

title: Password rate limiting not enforced on password reset endpoint
affected_customers: None (security hardening - no active exploitation reported)
workaround: No customer-facing workaround needed. Internal security fix in progress.

title: Welsh language documents not indexed for search (no Welsh language analyzer)
workaround: Welsh documents are stored and downloadable but not searchable by content. Index by metadata (title; tags) using English terms as a workaround.
